Lower Text: [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, add this card to the hand.
Upper Text: [Main] Choose 1 of your Digimon. Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon with DP less than or equal to that Digimon to the hand. Then, by returning the top card of one of your [Leopardmon: Leopard Mode] to the hand, unsuspend all of your Digimon.
